semantics.reset: active-high synchronous; reset has priority over in and sets state B
semantics.output: Moore output reflects current registered state; no combinational dependence on in or reset
semantics.initialization: State before a reset clock edge is unspecified; no power-up initialization required
semantics.sampling: in and reset are sampled on each rising clock edge; state and out hold between clock edges

numeric.arithmetic: No arithmetic datapath; Boolean state transitions only

verification.oracle: Independent named-state transition table derived from problem
directed: reset from both states with either input
reset asserted between edges must not change output
input changes between edges must not change output
verification.exhaustive: Enumerate all 256 length-eight binary input sequences after reset
verification.checks: Compare output after each rising edge and between edges; explicit dev_tb top, finite compile/simulation timeouts, fatal mismatch and final PASS

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Only assert deterministic behavior after synchronous reset
